# Teak Room Interiors

> Luxury interior design studio in Nilambur, Kerala, specializing in residential and commercial spaces, bespoke furniture, and 3D visualization.

## About
Teak Room Interiors designs high-end residential and commercial spaces across Kerala, merging architectural precision with organic materials — primarily teak-based craftsmanship.

## Services
- Residential Interior Design
- Commercial Interior Design
- Bespoke Furniture Design
- 3D Visualization & Animation
- Space Planning
- Renovation
